comment: Dr. Addiss is a very knowledgeable professor and he taught the FYS course I took, Multiple Interpretations of God and the Devil, very well. He stresses class participation in FYS. He is fairly clear in my opinion, and his class was pretty slow-paced.
Honestly, this guy is awesome. His class isn't too hard and its really easy to get a B or an A. Great class by a great teacher
going to be a lot of papers. :/

His class is pretty easy and he's a laid buy cool guy.  Discussions can be annoying though because he lets students talk the whole time when you really are sick of hearing your peers say things that are unbased.  Good teacher though, i suggest him.
Cool guy. very relaxed. Grading can be annoying. Very open to student ideas though

This guy is so chill, he's a great guy, leads discussions well, and not too hard of a grader--a little inconsistent but not bad at all--he's just the coolest.  And he likes field trips.  Very open to student suggestions, I miss him already!

most adorable, interesting man you will ever meet in your whole life. it is worth taking his class just to learn about the amazing life he has lead... you will be one of the only people you know to love core class if you have addiss
Addiss is the easiest and most interesting CORE teacher ever. be thankful if you get him.

Paper topics and grading can get a little tricky -but not hard. His class is laid back, discussion is very open and he is an intersting person. There is not a great amount of work and he is an interactive teacher.
